base.name: Erbacub

Discovered.text: A green, omnivorous cub scout. Erbacubs are frequently observed searching their surroundings for stones and twigs, typically accompanied by a buddy member of their own species.

First Caught.text: Erbacubs appear to organize themselves into tribal communities. At night, they establish campfires, seemingly to deter creatures of the dark, such as Ircencaats. They combine gathered materials to construct various items and demonstrate an understanding of which plants and berries are poisonous and which are not.

Experienced.text: Erbacubs are loyal scouts that undergo training in preparation for eventually assuming responsibility for the forest. Despite their training, they possess limited physical strength and are unable to exert significant force or pressure. They compensate for this limitation through cooperation. Although Erbacubs typically travel in groups, they are easily frightened by other creatures. Their moderately sharp claws are capable of cutting through vines with relative ease. Their vests also serve a practical function, providing storage for collected sticks.

Callside.text: A starter looking so similar to, you know, is a bit risky. I guess it paid off!

base.sacredSolution: Completes many merit badges, giving it the confidence and skills to do so. (also it gets a knife instead of sticks)

sacred.name: Sacred Erbacub
sacred.sacredSolution: An Erbacub covered in earned badges and patches, carrying a pocket knife.
sacred.visualDescription: An Erbacub covered in earned badges and patches, carrying a pocket knife.

First Caught.text: Bearosion patrols forests like a ranger. Its safari hat never falls off, even during battle. It exudes leadership and calm strength.
Hileaph towers over the forest, wielding a fallen tree. Its wide-brim safari hat casts a long shadow, under which others gather for safety.

base.name: Sparcoon

Discovered.text: A red, agile, and spontaneous creature. It propels itself throughout its environment, catching everything in magnificent flames throughout its travels. It enjoys reaching elevated places and then propelling off of them.

First Caught.text: Sparcoons never pay attention to their surroundings. If a location is in sight and jumping distance, they will try to reach it. Although Sparcoons are land Animates, they frequently propel themselves upwards with their tails. Regardless of their absolutely reckless behaviors, Sparcoons are generally friendly creatures, and are unable to recognize danger, especially the impressive flames they release.

Experienced.text: Sparcoons are extremely trusting. Despite their inattentiveness to their own surroundings, they are very capable of reading emotions. Having little understanding of the damage caused by the intense fires they spread during their constant movement, they try to save people from getting engulfed in the flames. Unfortunately, their inability to remain stationary, along with their lack of understanding of the cause of danger, makes these incidents very frequent. Additionally, Sparcoons almost never stay in the same area for long periods of time, and tend to try to explore as many environments as possible, making a second encounter with the same Sparcoon an exceptionally fortunate and unlikely occurrence.

Callside.text: Would you believe that these fire raccoons were originally named Charcoon? I agree.

base.sacredIssue: Cannot recognize the consequences of its own actions.
base.sacredSolution: Its tail absorbs high concentrations of heat nearby, fixing its messes and powering it up.

First Caught.text: Blazuki glides across tall heights and long distances, leaving streaks of embers in the air. Its fiery mohawk flares up even further when it flies, warning others of its incoming presence.

base.name: Axolitl

Discovered.text: A blue, small-bodied amphibian with an unusually large head. A purple, amethyst-like crystal appears to grow from its gills, weighing its head down considerably. It frequently supports itself with its stubby hands to remain upright.

First Caught.text: Axolitls are interesting little fellows. They seem to hear each other without speaking, and tend to waddle in groups. They struggle to pick their head up while standing still, and on occasion they end up scooting around on their behind. It could be assumed that their gemstone growth is not native to their species, as a few Axolitls have been observed without any crystals. Nonetheless, Axolitls seem determined to adapt to their circumstances. Whether they've had enough time to is another question.

Experienced.text: Axolitls are actually not as fascinating as one would believe at first. The truly interesting information resides in the crystalline constructs using them as hosts. The crystals are highly durable and are nearly impossible to remove from their Axolitl hosts without causing harm. It is suspected that the crystals target the Axolitls' gills for that very reason, as it makes them nearly impossible to remove and provides a direct entry point into the host’s body. Perhaps rapid movement would be able to loosen their grasp on the Axolitl’s body. However, it seems that Axolitls evolved with few natural predators, resulting in little need to develop the speed necessary to dislodge their parasites.

base.sacredIssue: Is not mutualistically benefited by its parasitic crystals.
base.sacredSolution: It allows the crystals to grow evenly across its body, as it allows it to gain strength and balance.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolitl
sacred.sacredSolution: It has extra crystals, improved posture, and Godzilla-like crystals along its body.
sacred.visualDescription: It has extra crystals, improved posture, and Godzilla-like crystals along its body.

First Caught.text: Axolote loses it's once gentle movements and now have an alien quality to them. It now also appears to mutter to itself in an unknown language.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolote
sacred.sacredSolution: Its upper torso is thinner, resembling a normal Axolarg.
sacred.visualDescription: Its upper torso is thinner, resembling a normal Axolarg.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolarg
sacred.sacredSolution: It wears a bulky Venom-like suit with two thinner arms extending from its back.
sacred.visualDescription: It wears a bulky Venom-like suit with two thinner arms extending from its back.

First Caught.text: Axolarg towers above its foes, with a hulking physique sculpted by its crystalline armor. The only part of its body not encased in crystals is its head, and a floating crystal hovers above it, pulsing with mysterious energy.

Discovered.text: A small, green creature with an unusually soft and malleable body. It is frequently found burrowing into fallen tangerines, leaving its sides exposed. They are rather slow, and their sweet scent is extremely alluring. Despite their vulnerabilities, Pretengerines are surprisingly easy to raise, especially in farmland.

First Caught.text: Pretengerines are excellent creatures to produce! They require very little space and enjoy being constantly fed. Their sweet scent makes them fantastic bait for a larger Animate. One must be careful removing them from fruit; they seem to meld themselves to the fruit, and ripping them out too quickly might harm both the Pretengerine and the fruit. A bit of patience is all that is necessary.

Experienced.text: Pretengerines are far smarter than most believe. They are capable of distinguishing caretakers from strangers and will wriggle excitedly when in the vicinity of an individual they recognize. They reproduce rather quickly, and their constant consumption of fruit, mostly tangerines, sweetens them up further. Ja, Pretengerine is mostly used for bait, but that doesn't mean it deserves poor treatment. They express love! When in love with another, they share their fruit with their partners, and sleep intertwined. Separating the two, even gently, causes them to no longer attach themselves to their fruit, becoming limp, possibly from heartbreak. It seems they are capable of understanding language, as there have been a few occasions where a Pretengerine heard the mention of a Bakunbush, and perked itself further out of its fruit.

Discovered.text: Espioranges appear to be overgrown Pretengerines! Their evolution occurs when a Pretengerine consumes far too much sugar. Interestingly, Espioranges appear to no longer care for fruit. However, it seems that old habits die hard, as they still wrap around the trees they used to collect from, seemingly out of familiarity. Despite that, Espioranges now appear to have no true protective shell.

base.name: Bakunbush

Discovered.text: An absolutely cute little oinker. Its torso is a bush that grows very delicious grapes! It also goes very fast when running from danger!

First Caught.text: Bakunbushes are cute little oinkers that love cuddling! They also love hanging out with their besties in the wild! Even if their new friends aren’t the best, they still try. Sometimes they even smush the grapes onto each other’s faces!

Experienced.text: Bakunbushes are Animates that tend to be regarded by “some” as adorable. This is partly due to their tendency to scrunch their faces, presumably while searching for others of their kind. Bakunbushes experience loneliness easily and frequently seek companionship. Their grapes also appear to become sweeter when they appreciate their surroundings and interactions. Unfortunately, being common prey, they are constantly on high alert. However, their low intelligence means that any Animate wishing to gain their trust simply needs to avoid provoking them for 5 seconds, after which they will regard it as a friend. Additionally, they tend to leave their “sign of friendship” by squishing their own grapes onto others. Overall, they are remarkably trusting, yet still capable Animates. Perhaps Bakunbushes’ evolution will support its safety despite its own obliviousness.

base.sacredIssue: It is unable to identify threats easily.
base.sacredSolution: Gains a sort of spidey-sense, where its grapes release a smell warning it, and deterring others when in danger. Additionally, its bush is able to puff outwards, hiding it.

sacred.name: Sacred Bakunbush
sacred.sacredSolution: Small branches and vine-like limbs grow grapes. It controls them like extra arms to whip, grab objects, or throw grapes at enemies from a distance.
sacred.visualDescription: Small branches and vine-like limbs grow grapes. It controls them like extra arms to whip, grab objects, or throw grapes at enemies from a distance.

sacred.name: Sacred Pigturee
sacred.sacredSolution: It has a longer, spikier tree-like trunk extension covered in bushy moss and even more grapevines, one of which curls into a grape goatee.
sacred.visualDescription: It has a longer, spikier tree-like trunk extension covered in bushy moss and even more grapevines, one of which curls into a grape goatee.

base.name: Statipillar

Discovered.text: They are a group of red and orange fuzzballs that all share a collective brain cell. About half of them annoy the other half, and vice versa. All of them are considerably uncoordinated, and seem to have absolutely no clue how to operate as a group. It’s highly doubtful they're attached by choice.

First Caught.text: Statipillar is, strangely, classified differently from other Animates. Despite being a bunch of individual creatures, they're always classified as one, presumably because they're always together. The reason they stay together, despite being so incapable of working as a team, is because they produce electricity that not only keeps them stuck to each other, but also pulls in any members that aren't already attached. So they are presumably stuck with each other indefinitely.

Experienced.text: Statipillar happens to be fully male. However, all the members of a Statipillar, who are perfectly capable of speaking, insist that females of their species exist. Nobody has ever found a female Statipill in the wild, let alone attached to a Statipillar. Despite their complete inability to coordinate, they're surprisingly good at surviving. About half seem responsible for movement, while the others collect food or try to look larger to scare off predators. Whether this is intentional cooperation is another question. Any predator foolish enough to attack one risks receiving a nasty shock, so it is not recommended to touch them without cotton or leather protection. Their feet also appear to be made of a rubbery material, possibly insulating them from their own electricity, but providing a shock to others equal to touching their fuzz.

base.sacredSolution: The red ones wear gold plates and the orange wear silver plates to conduct more electricity. They wear copper rope to make sure that they are all grounded, now representing a centipede more than a caterpillar. They are also now more electrifying, having white-blue electricity, but they are more locked in (they still goof around sometimes).

sacred.name: Sacred Statipillar
sacred.sacredSolution: The red variants wear gold plates and the orange variants wear silver plates to conduct more electricity. They wear copper rope to keep themselves grounded, resembling centipedes more than caterpillars. Their electricity is white-blue and they appear more focused.
sacred.visualDescription: The red variants wear gold plates and the orange variants wear silver plates to conduct more electricity. They wear copper rope to keep themselves grounded, resembling centipedes more than caterpillars. Their electricity is white-blue and they appear more focused.

base.name: Dribsom

Discovered.text: A gray, dysmorphic entity. It seems to be in constant distress, and yet insists on sneaking up on prey. It possesses excellent grip and a constant vocal tone. However, the creatures seem too small and young to understand how to use their abilities to their advantage.

First Caught.text: Dribsoms, despite their repulsive appearance at first glance, can cocoon themselves in their wings, appearing as a majestic shape. Dribsoms are incredible thieves when it comes to food, although they understand when food is being handed to them without needing to struggle. When given food, Dribsoms stop their hissing and instead begin to purr. It's a much more pleasant sound.

Experienced.text: Dribsoms are typically found in caves, forests, and alleys, always when it is dark. Despite being nocturnal, Dribsoms struggle to see at all. Instead, their violent flapping of wings, on top of announcing their location, creates vibrations that allow them to understand where they are going. Dribsoms often fight among themselves over food stolen in the dead of night, releasing their usual hiss-like screeches. They also tend to pick on smaller prey, but prefer stealing food rather than earning it.

base.sacredIssue: Is incapable of utilizing its abilities due to conditions.
base.sacredSolution: Develops a screamer personality, becoming more focused and capable of using audio to its advantage.

Discovered.text: With enough love and care, a Dribsom is capable of controlling its urges and using its skills in an effective manner. Now resembling a vocal screamer, Dribsom directs both its wing vibrations and screeches toward its prey, paralyzing them. It then attempts to swoop down and either attack its prey or steal food.

Experienced.text: Dribsom, even with its new skills, cannot resist being handed food. When given food, Dribsom now hums a tune before creating a “beat drop” and screeching nonstop. In the dead of night, this is rather unpleasant, unless a large predator is nearby, as the strength of its screech is enough to deter even the largest Animates. Additionally, Dribsoms learn to work in groups, paralyzing and subduing their prey with ease. Sharing their food afterwards is still a bit of a problem.

Discovered.text: Unlike Dribsom, it is a larger, multi-headed flying rodent. Despite the size increase and ability to observe several directions at once, it still struggles to focus. Additionally, it seems far more disoriented than before. One would think having three heads would be an improvement.

First Caught.text: Dribtars are very capable Animates, as when all three heads focus on one spot, they may be capable of screeching at volumes powerful enough to shatter glass. Unfortunately, they still fight amongst themselves, as opposed to others of their kind. It is unknown whether the heads are individually sentient. Dribtars are still just as soft as their previous stage, settling down immediately when given food.

Experienced.text: Dribtars, despite their shortcomings, are able to fight their opponents in a brawl and easily come out on top. Their grip strength and wing power are very easy to underestimate. When one of their heads gets hurt, the other two respond with anger, seemingly protective of each other. However, they often tumble through the air, trying to screech at one another. Luckily, their tussles often end with them vibrating the area around them enough to find food, at which point they immediately stop fighting. Their screeches are much louder now, and yet they seem to use them more frequently, possibly to provoke the other two heads, or because they are provoked by one of them.

Discovered.text: Unlike its normal variant, Sacred Dribtar follows in the footsteps of Sacred Dribsom and properly collaborates with its heads. They seem to truly enjoy screeching in unison as they soar through the air. Additionally, they seem much more receptive to being given food and are capable of being trained. Their sounds are also much louder, as they no longer waste energy fighting amongst themselves.

Experienced.text: Sacred Dribtar is a very energetic creature. It sometimes uses its multiple heads to scare, confuse, or trick others into giving it food. However, it also appears to understand sympathy. Perhaps this comes from its family of consciousnesses, or perhaps it learned from its caretakers. It chooses not to screech at certain individuals and Animates unless provoked. It can also go from calmly purring to becoming terribly agitated by a small sound in the distance. It appears to recognize its predators and opposition, as it screeches into bushes and trees when in the wild, but doesn't pursue whatever it targets. Dribtars have also been observed cocooning themselves in front of other Dribtars, waiting to see whether the other will cocoon beside them. That behavior is rather sweet, considering their outward personalities.

base.name: Ircencaat

Discovered.text: A shadowy, devilish feline. For some reason, it covers itself up in a patchy cloak and a thrown-together skull-like mask adorned with antlers. Its two beady, mischievous eyes are the only visible features of its face, darting around in strange patterns resembling those observed during REM sleep.

First Caught.text: Ircencaats are remarkably difficult to capture, and even in captivity, remain uncooperative during direct observation. They frequently hide beneath their cloaks and retreat into dark areas when approached. However, at night, when they are difficult to see, they attempt to frighten people and possibly pickpocket them. When hiding, their gaze appears to suggest curiosity rather than fear. Their eyes also exhibit rapid, irregular movements regardless of their activity.

Experienced.text: Ircencaats, tricksters by nature, are often caught stealing trinkets and playing pranks on humans; however, they appear to like children much better than adults, leaving the trinkets they steal in the possession of small children. It is additionally speculated that members of this species, much like humans, participate in organized religious ceremonies. They’re known to gather in circles and whisper fearfully in unison. Their garb is theorized to emulate some worshipped being. The consensus is that this being is the Serpent of Terror, Ghouliath, although they seem to be unable to properly portray it, judging by the quality and discrepancies between their outfits. It is difficult to get a proper image of one of them without a scan, as they recognize human sight and technology use, and will deliberately place obstacles between themselves and the individual observing them.

base.sacredIssue: Cannot do whatever it wants while conforming to a crude idea of a being.
base.sacredSolution: It now is a master of disguise, being able to pretend to be any other creature, although there’s always something off about it as it takes creative liberties.

sacred.name: Sacred Ircencaat
sacred.sacredSolution: Two Ircencaats share a trench coat, with one holding the other up to appear larger and more intimidating.
sacred.visualDescription: Two Ircencaats share a trench coat, with one holding the other up to appear larger and more intimidating.

costumes.name: Ghost Ircencaat
costumes.visualAppearance: An Ircencaat that is wearing a cut up table spread.

Discovered.text: A stickish bug resembling a surfboard. No clue whether it came first, but it still performs sick tricks when it runs onto the water and slides across its surface. It wears glasses, but it’s pretty obvious they are just its eyes.

base.name: Blarb

Discovered.text: A blue aquatic Animate with a large, flopping nose. It seems particularly fond of flaunting itself, parading around both on land and in the lake. It is additionally capable of traveling remarkably deep underwater.

First Caught.text: Blarb is a self-absorbed creature. It believes itself to be perfect, and while it has few problems, others do not recognize it as such. It understands language, and has even glanced over at an individual that complimented it.

Experienced.text: Blarb, despite its nature, has reasons behind its self-absorption. According to Blarb itself, it is regarded as a top candidate for controlling all of the lake. Blarb, having recently demonstrated its ability to speak, has admitted to having a full name: Blarbious Francais III. It is unknown whether all Blarbs have this name. Blarbs also sometimes stay together, but quickly disband when they begin to disagree on which among them is the best.

base.sacredIssue: The Animates around it do not recognize its perfection.
base.sacredSolution: Appear in a god-like form, wearing things that show its perfection. This gives Blarb some sort of control over the lake/water.

Discovered.text: Lo and behold, Blarb’s perfect version appears to have no issue showcasing itself to others. While humorous to scientists, this behavior notably works on the Animates surrounding it. Sacred Blarb also appears to have greater control over water. Perhaps this is what Blarb meant when it claimed it would control the lake.

Experienced.text: Blarb is a remarkable one. It is highly capable of manipulating water and additionally demonstrates an understanding of not just English, but other languages and even finance. Blarb is also capable of imitating the actions of others, often performing them with its own distinctive style. However, Blarb still has a tendency to explain how "blawesome" it is. This occasionally drives others away, but Blarb is nonetheless very well-liked.

Utilized.text: Blarb is now capable of controlling the lake. Despite the considerable power obtained through its Ace form, Blarb chooses not to alter what it considers its "perfect" appearance. Instead, it pilots a giant water-mech resembling itself. This is presumably intended to create a larger image of itself for advertisement. Blarb is certainly amusing. Despite being composed primarily of water, the mech should not be underestimated, as it is capable of high pressures of approximately 3,000 PSI.

base.name: Gaslug

Discovered.text: A green, slimy Animate with geysers all over its back. It commonly resides on the sides of the lake, but it occasionally crawls onto land. It appears to hold its breath before blowing water out of its geysers.

First Caught.text: Gaslugs are goopy Animates that follow a daily routine. They swim on the sides of the water, consuming any underwater Animates they can by waiting until they get close enough. Then, they go to shore when their Aqueductal Sac, the organ that stores unnecessary, ingested water, gets full. The sac expels all the water simultaneously through all the geysers on its top, allowing it to breathe underwater once more.

Experienced.text: Gaslugs, unfortunately, are rather vulnerable when their Aqueductal Sacs become full, as they lose the ability to breathe underwater until the water is expelled and become much slower. Interestingly, they seem capable of controlling the pressure of their expulsions, and have been seen aiming their geysers at potential predators when threatened. However, the geysers are not particularly accurate, and they miss often. It also appears that Gaslugs are unable to stop their expulsion once they begin, meaning they only get one continuous chance to aim. Gaslugs appear territorial toward other Animates when hunting, but become mellow afterwards, peacefully moving toward the shore to empty their sacs. Fortunately, Gaslugs seem to recognize humans and other Gaslugs, and only playfully point or spray at them from a distance.

base.sacredIssue: It is highly vulnerable when its AS fills.
base.sacredSolution: Extra geysers that appear small and can constantly expel water.

base.name: Quubbly

Discovered.text: A small, yellow quacker. It doesn’t seem particularly intelligent at first glance. However, it is remarkably cute. It follows its parent around everywhere, and seems to be able to stay afloat as easily as one would expect.

First Caught.text: Quubbly appears to be a small child, as evidenced by its obliviousness to its surroundings. It seems to get tired waddling outside the water, and much prefers to swim. Its life ring-esque design functions exactly as expected, providing buoyancy to Quubbly.

Experienced.text: Quubblies are extremely dependent on their parents, and become very distressed when separated from them. They frequently quack for attention, even when nothing is happening. Interestingly, their life rings seem to be a part of them, growing with them, and expanding when they breathe. Despite their inability to recognize faces, they always remember their parents, being able to pick them out of a group of others. Additionally, they have blind faith in whoever is holding, carrying, or leading them along, so it is best to leave them with their parents.

base.sacredIssue: It blindly trusts anybody that handles it.
base.sacredSolution: It can inflate its buoy body part, and begins floating. It can also release a lot of air, causing it to move extremely quickly on water.

Discovered.text: The parental guardian of Quubblies and Quontoons. They have a small pool-like structure on their back to hold their children, and their neck is long enough to feed them from it. They constantly stop to count their young, and seem to have only a singular off-color Quubbly with them.

An orange, scurrying Animate with a hard shell covering almost its entire body, except for a soft, fleshy posterior. This exposed portion appears particularly vulnerable to predators, which may explain why Fizzlets conceal it within discarded soda cans.

First Caught.text: When threatened, Fizzlets produce a hiss resembling a freshly opened soda can. Interestingly, shaking one beforehand may cause it to foam at the mouth. And before attacking, it sways from side to side and releases a stream of carbonated water. Why would it display signs of a soda can if the soda cans are only a shell for it? Could it go deeper? Perhaps the explanation will arrive with further research, although the theory is currently that Fizzlets adapted to the rules of sodas so as to deceive others of its existence.

Experienced.text: Fizzlets possess an internal mechanism capable of storing and releasing carbonation. Their defensive behavior of swaying has been proven to increase the pressure before releasing it. However, this raises an interesting idea, being that Fizzlets generate their own carbonation, or extract it from the soda cans they afterwards use as shells. Unfortunately, Fizzlets seem to starve themselves to death whenever not present with soda, including flavored water, Salgee, and other consumables, and so it would be impossible to determine where the carbonation originates without dissection.

Discovered.text: A brown rodent with a shovel-like tail. The tails seem to be extremely powerful, and their teeth are definitely no joke! Their fur seems to also be dirtphobic, as no sand or grime gets into their fur.

First Caught.text: Beabars are remarkably talented builders. Some are capable of building sandbars in just under an hour from scratch! Nonetheless, their enthusiasm is rather admirable, and their speed and strength are no less impressive. They are capable of launching water, sand, mud, and even other Animates using their tails! Unfortunately, they seem to struggle to aim their tails, which seems to be the only reason they don’t go even faster with construction.

Experienced.text: Beabars are extremely cooperative Animates. On top of frequently collaborating with other Beabars to construct enormous sandbars and other structures, they have assisted humans and other Animates in constructing their homes and dens. Interestingly, they also appear to have specific preferences when building, and are very stubborn about sticking by them. Despite occasionally disagreeing with each other, they never seem to abandon a project. Beabars have also been seen admiring their finished projects for minutes after completion. Beabars also seem to be capable of understanding language, although it has been so far only seen when telling them what the intended design of a home would be. Beabars, even if their intellect is limited, are powerful workers, and are respectable for that.

Discovered.text: A buoyant, floral Animate that resembles ordinary lily pads. Lilivines conceal enormous mouths lined with sharp teeth, opening them to launch surprise attacks. Their beautiful flowers contain their eyes, which are an easy indication of their true nature. However, these are more visible in younger Lilivines, whose flowers have not yet grown enough to disguise them.

First Caught.text: Lilivines are patient hunters, waiting for unsuspecting creatures to step onto them before opening their mouths. Interestingly enough, they appear sensitive to weight and disturbances in the water, yet Rebbles can jump beside or even onto them without provoking a reaction. Perhaps they recognize that Rebbles are composed of stone, and therefore unsuitable prey, suggesting complex thought rather than instinct. However, they do also try biting waves on occasion, so their capacity for thought remains uncertain.

Experienced.text: Lilivines have impressive hunting capabilities, and yet how they digest their prey remains unknown. Fortunately, to avoid any unfortunate accidents, Lilivines can be safely moved by pulling on their submerged rhizomes, avoiding contact with their mouths entirely. Their ability to remain motionless and hidden for extended periods has even tricked scanning machinery, which is admirable. It is believed they remain motionless to avoid distracting other Lilivines or disturbing possible prey. If only other Animates displayed such restraint instead of disturbing their surroundings.

Discovered.text: A bowl that contains an orange fish. It is unusually active for something made of such a fragile material, but it moves on as if piloted by another force. Additionally, the water inside of itself seems to be unable to spill from the top.

First Caught.text: Bowlfish is a very fast swimmer, and is able to dictate when the water from its insides spills and when it doesn’t. And it is able to, just the same, decide what outside fluids enter. It is able to reflect many attacks off its surface, despite being made of glass. It is assumed that a specific amount of pressure is needed to destroy it, although that threshold remains unknown.

Experienced.text: Bowlfish is not actually the bowl itself. Unbeknownst to everybody, Bowlfish is in fact the orange fish identified in the bowl. And so, the prior entries should be attributed to the machine this fish put together, somehow. Bowlfish, as in the orange fish, is apparently as smart as humans, being able to solve complex calculus problems, and has even finished an individual's taxes. As for the bowl, it is still rather impressive, as it too can roll on the ground or even hover without struggling to breathe. This equipment has been used to design a feature for Capture Capsules, and it has been continuing to be impressive over and over since.

costumes.name: Cauldron Bowlfish
costumes.visualAppearance: A Bowlfish modeled after a cauldron.

Discovered.text: A small aquatic fish with unusually reflective scales. They are rather timid Animates that tend to avoid confrontation. Interestingly, they appear to swim somewhere other than their actual location.

First Caught.text: Camoflishes are capable of refracting light through their scales, causing their bodies to appear in locations separate from their actual positions. They use this to their advantage, deceiving anybody trying to catch Camoflishes, causing them to go for empty water instead.

Experienced.text: Camoflishes are extremely peaceful Animates, spending most of their time swimming alone, even from other Camoflishes. Their scales are adjustable, allowing them to change their apparent positioning. Interestingly enough, they seem to be capable of recognizing other Camoflishes despite these distortions. Beyond that, there is little else that makes them unique. Perhaps that is all they need, and that’s just fine if they are perfectly content being alone.

Discovered.text: Two separate fish, conjoined together. Now unlike an Animate like Statipillar, this one appears to be born as siamese twins. However, it’s still uncoordinated like the rest of them, and can never seem to agree on a proper direction to swim. It seems as if both sides don’t realize the other is there.

First Caught.text: Confished is made up of two small fish; however, it’s apparent that the two fish have different roles. Despite swimming against each other, one fish seems to steer the two, and the stronger one seems to be the one that ends up moving them forwards. The two seem extremely oblivious to their surroundings, and do not swim away from danger. Although that might just be because of their incapability to work together.

Experienced.text: Confished apparently possesses a neurological deformity that affects coordination between its two halves. Nonetheless, the idea that the two sides are capable of working together to move is miraculous otherwise. Betting on Confished races has recently become a popular form of gambling. Despite their apparent helplessness, Confished have no natural predators. This may be due to their unusual anatomy, or simply because they have only recently appeared in nature. Whatever the case, they are lucky, as they can barely work together to swim.

sacred.name: Sacred Confished
sacred.sacredSolution: The pair works as a team instead of being equal in size or function. One is large and intimidating, while the long, lanky other hides behind it like a tail and strikes escaping or unsuspecting prey.
sacred.visualDescription: The pair works as a team instead of being equal in size or function. One is large and intimidating, while the long, lanky other hides behind it like a tail and strikes escaping or unsuspecting prey.

base.name: Cartilicht

Discovered.text: A collection of bones, somehow held together, resembling the remains of an aquatic Animate. It hangs a light in front of itself to detect predators and lure in prey. It also does not appear to breathe or consume anything, if it even could.

First Caught.text: Cartilichts are unusual hunters. They remain almost completely still, using their lights to attract prey before suddenly lunging towards them. However, they don’t appear to consume their captured prey, and instead release them afterwards. They are extremely durable, being able to survive both the thrashing of its prey when caught, and itself against surfaces when it is captured. Despite having no visible muscles, they swim rather quickly. It is unknown how they are “held together”.

Experienced.text: Cartilichts have no need to breathe, drink, or eat. Even after extended observation, Cartilichts have shown no signs of requiring or even searching for any of these.  Their hunting behaviors could then be assumed to be sport, as they continue to lure in prey despite gaining nothing from doing so. Interestingly, despite the Cartilicht not moving, their lights seem to respond to nearby movement, turning ever so slightly towards the source. Perhaps their hunting methods are an instinct retained from a previous life. Or hunting is a fun activity to pass the time for them. Cartilicht remains a mystery.

base.sacredIssue: Its light illuminates itself, and causes some Animates to avoid going to it, leaving it doing nothing.
base.sacredSolution: Its light becomes a blacklight, allowing it to make itself invisible to anything that has the light go in between it and the Cartilicht.

sacred.name: Sacred Cartilicht
sacred.sacredSolution: It uses blacklight to remain less obvious, attract prey, and see better in the dark.
sacred.visualDescription: It uses blacklight to remain less obvious, attract prey, and see better in the dark.

Discovered.text: A red creature found deep underwater in the lake. It seems very angry at me for some reason, so I should try staying away from it, and I’d advise everybody else to as well.

First Caught.text: Emene, even when caught, appears to still have a burning passion for hatred. Although, I did find out that Emene is not actually stuck to the ground, and can move around by scooching or by hopping. Its tendrils appear to have incredible grip strength, based on their movements.

Experienced.text: Emene is an absolute hater, and wants the suffering of everything around it. This includes other Emenes, interestingly enough. It also appears to understand language, as it starts hopping more aggressively whenever it hears one individual expressing compassion toward another. As suspected, its tendrils have incredible grip strength, and will not let go unless tickled. When grabbing an individual, it tries either squeezing them to death, or having them drown if underwater. Its giant eye also appears to be very powerful, as it can see things to ambush from about 90 feet away.

Discovered.text: It matches the legends. Ghouliath is a size-shifting serpentine with a skull at the front, and an eye in the mouth. It is a ghost, however it appears to still be able to move through the floor and grass. It seems territorial, and it emits loud screeches that are ear-wrenching. My heart stopped when I first saw it, and its roar only furthered my panic.

base.name: Salgee

First Caught.text: It slept at the bottom of the river for so long that algae grew over its body.

base.visualDescription: A sage-like fish with algae growing over its body.

base.name: Minnote

First Caught.text: It evolves based on the primary instrument it most recently heard.

base.visualDescription: A minnow shaped like a bass clef symbol.

sacred.name: Sacred Chordal
sacred.sacredSolution: It has a larger harp and hand-like fins that let it play faster, pluck multiple strings, and perform more complex songs.
sacred.visualDescription: It has a larger harp and hand-like fins that let it play faster, pluck multiple strings, and perform more complex songs.

base.name: Triangeel

First Caught.text: It strikes itself with its tail to make sound.

base.visualDescription: An eel shaped like a triangle.

base.name: Velvetone
base.visualDescription: A red velvetfish resembling an Electone organ.

base.name: Spigle
base.visualDescription: A shortspine thornyhead resembling a bugle.

base.name: Moshrill
base.visualDescription: Hyperactive, jumpy bugs with thick exoskeletons resembling skulls and glowing neon accents. Their ribbed shells rub together while they mosh, producing a sound like a heavy-metal scream.

base.name: Pyroad

First Caught.text: Its tail acts as a fuse, igniting the explosive attached to it and launching Pyroad forward.

base.visualDescription: A roadrunner with flame-igniting feet and a tail connected to a bomb or stick of dynamite.

base.name: Calloyte

First Caught.text: It eats Pyroads to trigger an explosion inside itself, which provides its energy.

base.visualDescription: A coyote resembling a metal firelighter.

base.name: Flikflek
base.visualDescription: A kangaroo rat with a tennis racket at the end of its tail.

base.name: Kangurru
base.visualDescription: A large kangaroo rat resembling a kangaroo, with a tennis racket at the end of its tail and a Flikflek in its pouch carrying another racket.

base.name: Hachit
base.visualDescription: A baby scorpion with an axe-shaped tail and tiny single-line claws used to hold things in place.

base.name: Cluchit
base.visualDescription: A medium-sized scorpion with an axe-shaped tail, normal scorpion claws, and tiny needles all over its body that weaken an opponent's grip.

base.name: Graspit
base.visualDescription: A large scorpion with three tails. Its left and right tails act as shackles that lock onto limbs, while its center tail resembles Cluchit's. Heavy, stone-like armor covers its main body.

base.name: Limirail
base.visualDescription: A toy train-like creature whose size and apparent distance change depending on how its observer perceives it.

First Caught.text: It creates mirages that duplicate its appearance.

base.name: Anchophant
base.visualDescription: A small desert elephant with extremely long tusks that it drives into the ground to launch itself through the air.

base.name: Nudinde
base.visualDescription: A small slug riding a dandelion, with gills that imitate the dandelion's puffs.

base.name: Alpacalypse
base.visualDescription: A huge, peaceful alpaca with a long neck and dark, rolling storm-cloud fleece. It may have a third eye and is regarded as an omen of the end of the world.

base.name: Therpo
base.visualDescription: A snake-esque creature that is constantly tripping because its own hallucinogenic thorns prick it.

base.name: Doereme
base.visualDescription: A doe wearing a sleeping cap, with fur resembling a blanket.

base.name: Bamzai
base.visualDescription: A small bonsai plant with a sapling growing from its top.

ace.name: Ace Bamzaiken/Bamzumo
ace.visualDescription: A huge, hulking humanoid flowerpot with a beanstalk growing from its top. It carries two scythes shaped like a pair of scissors.

base.name: Bamzaiken

First Caught.text: It can fire energy slashes from its scythe.

base.visualDescription: A humanoid flowerpot with a cherry tree growing from its top. It carries a scythe shaped somewhat like a hoe.

Discovered.text: A small, gray, spherical Animate with a large, feathered headdress. It appears to fly by bouncing off nearby surfaces, strangely gaining speed and height with every impact. Despite this, it seems completely unharmed, and even enjoys the collisions, chirping each time. I really enjoy using it to play a game on the beach!

base.name: Calendolly
base.visualDescription: This sweet creature has a body formed of soft yellow petals and flowers, molded together with candle wax. It always smells pleasant, and it’s a cheerful lad, so children are often given it as a friend. They are craftable, as the special flower they are made from ks what gives them light. Just mix candle wax and the special flower petals and leaves and viola, a loyal buddy. They love to be useful and use their arms as candles to illuminate the world around them. They can be made in all sizes but are typically kept small so they still have structural integrity. Don’t try to make one too big. You’ll regret it.

sacred.name: Sacred Saplite
sacred.sacredSolution: Its squid-like vine legs are longer. Its head has an edamame mohawk, and it can shoot edamame beans from its mouth.
sacred.visualDescription: Its squid-like vine legs are longer. Its head has an edamame mohawk, and it can shoot edamame beans from its mouth.

sacred.name: Sacred Dreadbloom
sacred.sacredSolution: It can brighten, darken, or change its color to camouflage itself and attract things. Its teeth and stem are much longer.
sacred.visualDescription: It can brighten, darken, or change its color to camouflage itself and attract things. Its teeth and stem are much longer.

sacred.name: Sacred Rosophagus
sacred.sacredSolution: Its stem is longer and it has additional leaves resembling a bellflower. It has a retractable uvula used to disorient creatures before catching and eating them.
sacred.visualDescription: Its stem is longer and it has additional leaves resembling a bellflower. It has a retractable uvula used to disorient creatures before catching and eating them.

sacred.name: Sacred Pollutron
sacred.sacredSolution: Its vines are longer, and its sides contain cannons that fire coconuts.
sacred.visualDescription: Its vines are longer, and its sides contain cannons that fire coconuts.

base.name: Growool
base.visualDescription: A small wolf pup with the legs of a lamb.

base.name: Furgery
base.visualDescription: A sheep wearing a frightening wolf or dog costume.

base.name: Weredyagoat
base.visualDescription: A wendigo wearing a werewolf costume. The costume's head is beginning to tear, revealing parts of the skull beneath it.

base.name: Gloalese
base.visualDescription: Resembles a siphonophore in shape, a bit like a singular tentacle. When not producing electricity, its outline is formed by small, spherical, black, rice-sized creatures. They function as an electric grid: when producing electricity between themselves, blue lines appear between the spheres, producing the actual design of the animate.

base.name: Ilunion
base.visualDescription: Like Gloalese, its body is formed by small black spheres connected by blue lines of electricity. It resembles a strange in-between of an octopus and a jellyfish, with a head similar to an octopus and many jellyfish tentacles joining together to create a thick tentacle.

base.name: Bewag
base.visualDescription: A red fleshy ghost, giving a slight transparent (but not actually) effect. The limbs are stretched beyond human-like, and the eyes are hollowed out.

base.name: Shiver Shocks
base.visualDescription: Looks extremely similar to Nonignite, however is notable a robot version. Rather than being a lava lamp, it is a plasma lamp. The suckers on it's tentacles are now defibrillators. Instead of the UPRO logo (on the current model), it has a yellow cross. Shiver Shocks is used for heart support, which is why it is found in hospitals and sometimes buildings, homes, and schools.

sacred.name: Sacred Krat
sacred.sacredSolution: Instead of swinging and hopping wildly, it balances calmly on one leg with an upright posture.
sacred.visualDescription: Instead of swinging and hopping wildly, it balances calmly on one leg with an upright posture.

sacred.name: Sacred Kroxer
sacred.sacredSolution: It wears white bandanas, including one covering its eyes, and balances on one leg with a leaner build and more defined leg muscles.
sacred.visualDescription: It wears white bandanas, including one covering its eyes, and balances on one leg with a leaner build and more defined leg muscles.

base.name: Gloobie
base.visualDescription: A creature that resembles a smoothie inside of a blender. The blender itself is not part of the Gloobie. Little is known about them, except for the fact that they are simply the eyes inside of the blender, and not the liquid they take over or the blender, although they are never seen without either. Perhaps they are a bacteria, or fungus of some sort. People also tend to turn the blenders on, which the creature seems to feel pain and amusement from.

base.name: Slurpent
base.visualDescription: An extremely long silly staw snake. That's really it.

Discovered.text: Little guy looks like a scrumptious snack, and he's a huge crybaby. He’s constantly crying over something, and most of the time, nobody gets his problem. You can give him food, attention, whatever, and he’ll still find something to complain about. Like what can he possibly be crying about? It does appear that he cries his own inner fluids non-stop, so it’s safe to assume he generates the fluid at a higher rate than he cries it out.

Unlike Buntot, Challadin is a big boy. They are loafy warriors, and carry large breadknife swords and cookies that taste exactly like half-moon cookies. These guys do not mess around at all. When doing their work, they are locked in, and protect others very seriously. However, it seems they enjoy relaxing in the heat, which could be an easy distraction for them. Challadin isn’t just bread, he is built like the whole bakery!

base.name: Frankfortress
base.visualDescription: A fortress made of hotdog/sausages. I'm sure this isn't that hard to conceptualize.

base.name: Cnidofish
base.visualDescription: A Crossota Jellyfish that has a small outlet on the top of it's face (yes it has the little outlet face), with small wires coming out the bottom. It searches for people to attach it's wires onto, to steal the electricity from their body.

base.name: Scyphon
base.visualDescription: A jellyfish that wraps it cables around something in a spiral shape, only to use the creature it wrapped around as a object to use as a way to tesla itself to charge.

sacred.name: Sacred Starpod
sacred.sacredSolution: It has a giant bubble blower on its back resembling a frog's throat sac. When sufficiently inflated, it releases a massive bubble that refracts light around it and renders it effectively invisible.
sacred.visualDescription: It has a giant bubble blower on its back resembling a frog's throat sac. When sufficiently inflated, it releases a massive bubble that refracts light around it and renders it effectively invisible.

Discovered.text: A pretty tough fellow. It’s hard as a rock, and pointy like a stalagmite. However, it ain’t heavy at all, and skips around like a crazy one. It doesn't seem to understand speech, but it well understands disapproval, because it gosh darn does the opposite of what it’s told to do.

base.name: Aurumaton

First Caught.text: Each time it is struck, more of its body turns golden.

base.visualDescription: A huge clay golem with golden repairs spreading across its body.

base.name: Cannitil
base.visualDescription: A large, moderately round stone with a strange face chiseled into it. It can float but usually rolls to avoid cracking itself from the strain.

base.name: Aggranite
base.visualDescription: A much larger version of Cannitil, resembling a boulder. It coats itself in mud to avoid chipping while it flies.

base.name: Runaiolate
base.visualDescription: An Aggranite permanently coated in Sub-Lava. It resembles obsidian and spins with tremendous speed.

base.name: Babahl
base.visualDescription: A goat whose horns curve far enough for it to roll on them.

base.name: Robenhoodie
base.visualDescription: A caped robin that fires its feathers.

base.name: Beakon
base.visualDescription: A frigatebird that fires a laser beam.

Discovered.text: An extremely explosive Animate. It soars through the sky, creating sparks in the air around it. When colliding with an obstacle at high speeds, it releases an explosion surrounding itself. Additionally, its feathers resemble flames. When not flying around and blowing things up, it perches high up and broods.

base.name: Scregling
base.visualDescription: A small creature with broad flying-fish wings instead of arms, dense photosynthetic fur that grows greener and brighter with sunlight, a smooth bioluminescent face, and a bare bone-like jaw.

base.name: Hexkwet
base.visualDescription: A mountain bird that attacks with its own shadow and can become a shadow to rest. Its bald head appears to have no skin, exposing only its skull.

base.name: Vultumbra
base.visualDescription: A bird with an enormous wingspan and light-absorbing feathers that prevent light from passing through. It has Ghouliath's skull and can wrap itself in its wings to merge with darkness and travel between shadows.

base.name: Aguipesh
base.visualDescription: A water panther represented as an oversized lynx with subtle draconic traits and dorsal plates along the top of its body.

base.name: Thundrake
base.visualDescription: A thunderbird represented as a brightly colored bird with a serious brow and lightning radiating from its body. It has feathered pterodactyl-like wings, and its head and neck can twist completely around beyond the range of an owl.

base.name: Soxafone
base.visualDescription: A sock shaped like a saxophone.

sacred.name: Sacred Paranger
sacred.sacredSolution: It uses static electricity through its clothing to discourage people from touching it or trying on the merchandise. It may wear gloves that project an electric field, and the face above it appears more concentrated.
sacred.visualDescription: It uses static electricity through its clothing to discourage people from touching it or trying on the merchandise. It may wear gloves that project an electric field, and the face above it appears more concentrated.

sacred.name: Sacred Fonceer
sacred.sacredSolution: Its pocket watch hangs from its waist. It carries a magician's cane and performs a magic trick with a lighter while smoking a cigar. The face above it appears more concentrated.
sacred.visualDescription: Its pocket watch hangs from its waist. It carries a magician's cane and performs a magic trick with a lighter while smoking a cigar. The face above it appears more concentrated.

sacred.name: Sacred Dressiani
sacred.sacredSolution: Her outer layer is visible around the clothing. Her moisturized body, a figment of light taking human form, can extend through partially visible, reflective liquid movement.
sacred.visualDescription: Her outer layer is visible around the clothing. Her moisturized body, a figment of light taking human form, can extend through partially visible, reflective liquid movement.

costumes.name: Apparition Dressiani
costumes.visualAppearance: Dressiani with a gray gown, and a flower crown.

base.name: Purrl
base.visualDescription: A knitted ball or hacky sack resembling a cat.

base.name: Knitten
base.visualDescription: A cat-shaped plush made entirely from knitted fabric.

First Caught.text: It is grumpy because it cannot get any sleep.

base.name: Vigilith

Discovered.text: …it is a small, orange version. It needs to be able to capture ghosts inside of itself, which weighs it down. Additionally, it will have a blindfold in order to block the entry and exit to the container. All of that carries over.

base.visualDescription: Blindfold (for see no evil), similar design to Statue of Liberty (Green-Orange Designs, Dress, Crown), and not as beanish.

base.name: Signilith

Discovered.text: Signiliths mark the end of our ghostly calamity! The bell inside its body allows it to alert the people and Vigiliths of ghosts. Its senses are deprived so that it will remain undivided in its purpose.

base.visualDescription: Gag-esque feature (for say no evil), similar design to Lincoln Memorial, openable chest cavity with Huge Bell inside (Liberty Bell), Arms and Legs like Insane Asylum. (It also is in a curled up pose)

base.name: Agilith
base.visualDescription: Destroyed/Cracked Ear Holes (for hear no evil), similar design to Freedom (White, Dress, Crown), and can should imply being able to compress and extend.

Discovered.text: Do not be alarmed, Caraptors willingly and excitedly function as your average run-of-the-mill car. Their legs might occasionally make having wheels pointless, but if anything, they just make the car faster. And if you are wondering how your Keidromae became larger, please do not ask. It is unknown what specifically evolves when it comes to them.

base.name: Sealibber
base.visualDescription: A seal that cools things down to relax them.

Discovered.text: A small white raptor-looking creature. They can be found in the colder regions of New Canadia, and are often found playing with their pack mates.

First Caught.text: They seem to be an incredibly social and loyal species, always loving accompaniment. They love to run around on cooler nights, playing with their owners and other friendly Animates. They use their blue smoke to hide from fellow Animates or potential threats, or to just keep an ice pop from melting. They seem to have some form of intelligence, and are able to perform simple tasks for their owners.

Experienced.text: Blizards are incredibly loyal and defensive around those they consider friends. They may seem cute from the outside, but they have razor sharp claws and teeth that can tear flesh apart with ease. The fluffy area around their necks provides both warmth and protection, acting as a secondary barrier against deadly attacks.

Discovered.text: A white, brown, and very playful Animate. Thick blue smoke emerges from their mouths, and yet they exhibit playful demeanors. They can be found in small packs, playing and hunting with fellow Cryodons. Despite this, they seem to be armed with sharp claws and a spiky tail.

First Caught.text: Cryodons seem to hunt in organized packs, displaying some form of group intelligence. At night, their deep howling can be heard throughout New Canadia, possibly to communicate with fellow Cryodons.

Experienced.text: Cryodons are loyal Animates who will stop at nothing to protect their owners and pack mates, including Animates not of their species. They are very friendly and playful creatures, and have very high energy, contrary to their bulky build. Despite this, they are very dangerous, capable of delivering strong blows with their tail and paws. Their claws are sharp enough to easily rake through tough materials like metal and concrete.

base.name: Serventine
base.visualDescription: A male cobra dressed as a butler.

base.name: Maidusa
base.visualDescription: A female cobra dressed as a maid.

base.name: Antendett
base.visualDescription: An ant dressed as a waiter.

base.name: Mulchimaw

First Caught.text: Its body is made of rotting plants and releases a horrid smell.

base.visualDescription: A small dragon with an unusually long neck, thorns for horns, and mushrooms growing from its neck to its head.

base.name: Detritan

First Caught.text: It causes decay around itself to gather more material for its body. Because its accumulated plant matter makes movement difficult, it spends most of its time in murky water to keep itself damp. Some call it a monster of the bodies of water it inhabits.

base.visualDescription: A large dragon whose body is made from a landfill's worth of decaying plants, with mushrooms and thorns protruding all over it.

base.name: Lambabeem
base.visualDescription: A sheep with colored glass instead of wool and a lightbulb in its back that illuminates the night.

base.name: Canvox
base.visualDescription: A fox made of paint with a thistle for a tail.

base.name: Markara
base.description: As the Paragon of Freedom, she compels individuality and self-expression. She covers surfaces with murals, graffiti, and symbols that reflect the identities, emotions, and stories of those around her. Yet freedom is also her burden. She refuses to be defined by any rule, expectation, style, or identity, constantly reinventing her ideals, art, and personality.
base.visualDescription: A female Animate composed of what is believed to be fire, despite it constantly changing color. She wears red sneakers, a tie-dye cropped hoodie, athletic shorts, a black cap, and black fingerless gloves. Her hair resembles a plume of spread-out spray paint.

base.name: Nostralatu

First Caught.text: It seeks out smells, but once it has smelled something specific, it never seeks out that scent again. Garlic is deadly to it.

base.visualDescription: A vampire with a large nose and a traditional vampire cloak shaped somewhat like a nose silhouette.

base.name: Tenwreck
base.visualDescription: A small, fierce electric mammal with electric spines. Its dropped spines illuminate its underground home, and the spines glow like an overloaded lightbulb when it becomes angry.

base.name: Voltum
base.visualDescription: An electrically charged hummingbird that zigzags through the air like lightning. Its wings glow hot with sparks as it constantly releases energy.

base.name: Quillcoil
base.visualDescription: A robotic porcupine with a magnetic back. It reverses its magnetism to fire the metal rods from its back and then draws them in again.

base.name: Walmare
base.visualDescription: A Trojan-horse virus that takes the form of any living party member. Its default form is a horse made of Corrupted Ice.

base.name: Shiver Pests
base.visualDescription: Extremely small bug creatures, comparable in design but not based off of Prismite in universe or irl. They are extremely small, and only appear as black dots to the naked eye. However, they may fuse together as little nanobots to do tasks, similarly to ants.

Discovered.text: “Shiver Waves can connect to the internet! Just look at them, and you'll see their happy faces on the television screens. Ask them anything. They know everything! Until we figure out how to make them mobile, they will need to stay on their tower.”

“Shiver Blades was designed after a fan. Stretch it, turn it on, and watch it spin. But don’t think that that’s it. You can switch between heating and cooling modes, or as I prefer saying, Cool Mode and Heat Mode! It can even talk!”

base.name: Shiver Vlogs
base.visualDescription: Based off of Sapphae, however her Sapphire head is instead replaced with a camera, with a great focusing lens.

base.name: Icarphus
base.visualDescription: A skeleton-wax pigeon. It has melted part of its body and is incapable of flight.

base.name: Daedo
base.visualDescription: A skeleton-wax dodo bird. Half of its body is melted; its wings are entirely melted, leaving tough, skeletal-looking wax foundations. Its head is half melted open to reveal a skull. Its lower half has melted so much that its legs are longer than they should be and much thicker toward the bottom.

base.name: Macarino
base.visualDescription: A rhinoceros made of macaroni and cheese. Its humps are melted cheese, while the rest of its body is pasta.

base.name: Cadoink
base.visualDescription: A small pig formed from dreams of flight. Until that dream becomes big enough, it remains food to eat.
base.visualAppearance: A small pig formed from dreams of flight. Until that dream becomes big enough, it remains food to eat.

base.name: Aerodirve
base.visualDescription: The dream has become big enough, and now it can fly, using its blanket as a cape before snuggling with it later. Sometimes it even helps other dreams fly.
base.visualAppearance: The dream has become big enough, and now it can fly, using its blanket as a cape before snuggling with it later. Sometimes it even helps other dreams fly.

base.name: Countton
base.visualDescription: A sheep formed from the amount of people counting them. It travels as a pack and can fade into another one of itself until it helps someone sleep.
base.visualAppearance: A sheep formed from the amount of people counting them. It travels as a pack and can fade into another one of itself until it helps someone sleep.

base.name: Chibeats
base.visualDescription: Three small wind-chime-looking creatures. Every time one of them jumps, they play a sound.
base.visualAppearance: Three small wind-chime-looking creatures. Every time one of them jumps, they play a sound.

base.name: Soothspheer
base.visualDescription: Soothspheers are crystal balls with clouds surrounding them like puffy jacket fur.
base.visualAppearance: Soothspheers are crystal balls with clouds surrounding them like puffy jacket fur.

base.name: Carcrista
base.visualDescription: A Soothspheer that has evoked the dreams of others to be cured of Axo-Shards. They are made of Axo-Shards that do not infect, but instead shatter any real Axo-Shards that come into contact with them. She takes design elements from Lemody, Axolote, and Soothspheer.
base.visualAppearance: A Soothspheer that has evoked the dreams of others to be cured of Axo-Shards. They are made of Axo-Shards that do not infect, but instead shatter any real Axo-Shards that come into contact with them. She takes design elements from Lemody, Axolote, and Soothspheer.

base.name: Scadam
base.visualDescription: A robot plugged into the ceiling of a container filled with an unknown fluid. It controls others while experiencing all of their pain and resistance. The machine it is plugged into keeps it alive regardless of how much damage it takes. Experiencing genuine love through someone it controls could fix it, but nothing has ever entered the nightmare zone with love.
base.visualAppearance: A robot plugged into the ceiling of a container filled with an unknown fluid. It controls others while experiencing all of their pain and resistance. The machine it is plugged into keeps it alive regardless of how much damage it takes. Experiencing genuine love through someone it controls could fix it, but nothing has ever entered the nightmare zone with love.

base.name: Dauntecoon
base.visualDescription: A plush version of Sparcoon abandoned by Kal due to unfortunate circumstances. It was possessed by a famous author while still in Kal’s possession and felt betrayed when left on the Axo-Skerry. It can reveal a hideous monster form, but otherwise is just a small plush. It can also turn into its original human body, wearing an elongated Blazuki-esque fursuit despite being a messed-up version of the plush.
base.visualAppearance: A plush version of Sparcoon abandoned by Kal due to unfortunate circumstances. It was possessed by a famous author while still in Kal’s possession and felt betrayed when left on the Axo-Skerry. It can reveal a hideous monster form, but otherwise is just a small plush. It can also turn into its original human body, wearing an elongated Blazuki-esque fursuit despite being a messed-up version of the plush.

base.name: Skroptera
base.visualDescription: A robotic creature assembled in the image of a mannequin from scraps of different devices. It has butterfly-like parts and eight arms that seem to fly, connected to its body by only a few strings. It crawls across ceilings and sometimes uses the strings to hover. It is highly hostile to everyone except its creator.

Discovered.text: A tree-like Animate with a peculiar attraction to music. When exposed to melodies, they begin dancing. They additionally slide along the ground to the source of sound, without any apparent damage to their bodies or the ground. How they accomplish this is unknown, but they are graceful indeed.

First Caught.text: Grovys are quite social Animates. When gathered together, a zantifeeld of Grovys forms different shapes while dancing, most commonly circles. Interestingly, they have also been observed standing before ordinary trees, seemingly attempting to seduce them. Whether they recognize the differences between themselves and trees is uncertain. However, it is confirmed that they recognize differences between themselves and other variants, as they mix up their dances when they socialize.

Experienced.text: Grovys are generally peaceful and social; however, their singing is anything but peaceful. Often mistaken for happiness, singing indicates anger, and nearby Grovys may coordinate to surround whoever disturbed them. Their cooperation is impressive, even when trapping creatures between them. This does not occur between different Grovy variants, suggesting some sort of environmental hive mind rather than a species-wide one. Alternatively, they could release pheromones that differ between variants, preventing them from recognizing each other's signals. Nonetheless, let a Grovy have its music, and let it perform. They do happen to be fantastic dancers.

goner.name: Teepy
goner.visualDescription: A teepee made of toilet paper.

base.name: Splad
base.visualDescription: A mostly blue-and-white, spade-esque creature with a hooded top. Its bottom appendage lets it bounce high and far, but it cannot stick the landing; it lands on its face, destroying the ground and bouncing it into the air with itself.

base.name: Thrieline
base.visualDescription: A large three-headed cat. The cats do not share one consciousness and all want to do their own thing, but are unable to. All three are thrill seekers.

base.name: Poken
base.visualDescription: A small poker chip with two stubby legs and a dog face.

base.name: Alphallen
base.visualDescription: A giant wolf-shaped creature made of poker chips. Its limbs are solid black, its poker-chip spine and torso shake in a wave whenever it moves, and it wears a crown.

base.name: Juckle
base.visualDescription: A black-and-red jester that believes toys are the true people and people are toys. It juggles two balls resembling the realms and sometimes its own head; sources state that after its seemingly infinite routine, it puts its head back in a box.

base.name: Popuppet
base.visualDescription: A black-and-white wooden-toy humanoid with nearly hidden dog ears and a dog nose. It wears cat-like fake eyes-and-nose glasses, offers a blue pill and a red pill, and instinctively plays fetch if one is thrown.

base.name: Adonine
base.visualDescription: An armored evolution of Popuppet that flies with its cat tail and further hides its dog traits. Its armor gives it a stronger build and turns its hands into claw-tipped blasters that fire the same pills it carried before.

npc.description: A color-altered Skip, with a Sheriff outfit.
